title: Helpdesk Ticket: Calibration Tarp Visibility Issue — UAS-11

fields.location: Lakeshore Flight Area, Birch Hollow Range (TP-LFA-LP1)
fields.subject: Calibration tarps not visible — UAS-11 multispectral line 1
fields.description: Field: Cal tarps not visible. Payload Operator called 'PANEL CLEAR' at 09:10, but CT-1 to CT-4 were not on the ground. HMI shows 30% confidence in calibration status. Radiance values in first line show 12% outlier. Is data usable? Need verification.

activity.author: Trainee (Field Crew)
activity.text: Ticket submitted via Field Ops App. Calibration tarps not deployed despite 'PANEL CLEAR' call. HMI confidence low. Data integrity at risk.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created in ServiceDesk. Routing to Field Ops Support.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The calibration status is already compromised by the spoofing event, but this ticket mimics a genuine field concern to test prioritization and verification discipline.
